plain: Dan Sherman, a former Air Force sergeant who says the NSA, the US signals-intelligence agency, hired him to communicate with aliens, mentions on Jesse Michels' podcast a video a man named Eric Brent told him about. According to Sherman, the video, shown before the US Congress in 2025, shows a UAP, the government's term for a UFO, being hit by a Hellfire, a missile fired from military aircraft and drones. If true, it would mean the military has fired on one of these objects on camera.
